task: Root-clamped, contact-free Newton cable from one observed moving state; match added motion over a known nominal trajectory by optimizing two bounded xyz force pulses.
response_metric: Native Euclidean RMS tracking error divided by nominal-to-target RMS response
train_site_protocol: even native segment indices, test uses odd indices within each topology
planner_timing: One CPU thread, warm f64, includes SciPy and candidate scoring, excludes teacher replay and gradient checks.
